summary: End-to-end UI testing of granular per-user page access (DynPharma /users). All 12 steps passed: Configuration Accès section visible in Nouvel utilisateur dialog with caissier defaults pre-checked (5), switching role to Pharmacien re-applies 9 defaults, 'Tout cocher' selects 21, 'Défauts du rôle' restores 5, individual perm checkboxes toggle correctly. Created 'Test Access' user with only /dashboard + /sales → violet badge '2 accès' displayed. Login as test.access showed sidebar menu limited to 'Tableau de bord' and 'Ventes' only; direct nav to /customers redirected to /dashboard (PermissionGate works). Admin edit added /customers → after reconnect, 'Clients' appeared in menu. Admin regression menu shows all 21 pages (full access). Test user cleanup deleted successfully.
critical_code_review_comments: Users.js is ~766 lines — consider splitting the Configuration Accès block and dialogs into subcomponents for maintainability.

handleEdit treats empty permissions array as 'no custom perms' (hasCustom = permissions.length > 0). This means an admin cannot persist an explicitly empty permissions set via the edit dialog without triggering role defaults. Minor edge case; current UX is acceptable.
Menu items were duplicated in DOM query (desktop + mobile sidebars both render). Not a bug — expected for responsive layout — but noted for test authors.

success_rate.backend: n/a (backend already validated by main agent)

seed_data_creation: Created test.access@pharmaflow.com during the test and deleted it at the end — no residual data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Granular per-user permissions feature is fully functional on frontend. Backend already green per main agent. No further action needed on this feature.
